original_card.question: What exact content and credit of a small named PR set has already been retained?
methods: Compare exact heads and retained artifacts to write a source-bound disposition receipt.
Audit an existing receipt for missing content or predecessor attribution.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Separate complete integration, partial retention and changed heads; make no autonomous closures.

first_step.inspect: Read one small PR set in the ledger and identify exact reviewed heads and unresolved content.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Compare that set to retained artifacts; produce a complete or explicitly partial disposition receipt.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Reliable overlap evidence preserves credit and prevents repeated review of already-retained material.
allowed_variations: One small related PR family or one existing integration receipt.
scope_change_triggers: Treating matching titles or one shared blob as proof of full incorporation.

actual_scope: Audit archives-pr2980-2981.json against its sixteen installed blobs, the two decision heads and the predecessor sentences in the retained READMEs.
scope_change_reason: The card allows one existing integration receipt. This package audits that two-PR archive. It does not close either pull request.
bottleneck_link: The source-retention pass keeps the sixteen blobs. The open scientific review and the predecessor sentences outside the receipt are what a later reader still has to separate.
stop_rule: Audit this one receipt. Do not close the pull requests and do not treat the source-retention pass as scientific integration.
evidence: Sixteen installed blobs match the tree. Both decisions stay partially reviewed, with unchanged heads and archive-only closure. Four README predecessor sentences are outside the receipt and the two contributor lines.
author: jwr
ai_assistance: Substantial assistance from the Cursor coding agent in the execution, checker and writeup.
no_open_questions_reason: This receipt's sixteen blobs, two heads and four README predecessor sentences are the set. Another receipt would leave this disposition.
